quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: *sigh* Is this... the corrosive power of the dark remnants?

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Such terrible strength... I can't do anything against it no matter how hard I try...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: It has been some time, Sefana.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Wait, do my eyes deceive me? ... It's you, Sister Sorush! You're back!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: The Sunyata Flowers are saved... Ah, I've been waiting for so long, and hope has finally arrived!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: You won't suddenly leave again, will you? You won't be gone for a long, long time, right? Right?

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Don't get so worked up, Sefana! I will help you rescue the Sunyata Flowers, fret not!

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: #This is my Yasnapati, {NICKNAME}, and {M#his}{F#her} companion, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: We have already extinguished the Sign of Apaosha, and have rescued flower ponds from dark corrosion. Leave the ponds under your charge to us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that sure was straightforward! Given what Sefana calls you, you two sure seem like you have a close relationship!

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Close? I would not say so... though we did spend some time together and share some experiences...

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Hmm, while I'm not sure why you're speaking a little differently, Sorush, I'll have you two know that she took great care of me in the past!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: She said before the Sunyata Flower... "I shall be Simurgh's equal"... They encouraged me more than any teachings might.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: From that day on, I have believed that her will was most commendable.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: That's why I decided to follow the human custom of addressing one's elders when it comes to her, to show my respect!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sure gets Paimon thinking. Ah, she can see it now...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: St—Stop mentioning things from so long ago!

choices.text: Let's take a quick gander back to our original topic...

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Right, Sister. Does your Yasnapati not understand much about the Sunyata Flowers? Perhaps I can introduce them, on behalf of the elders...

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: There was a Pari who once sang thus—

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: "This coalescence of color is the miraculous sign of the flowing spring of life"...

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: "Linger here with me, dance and sing with me, let us weave lasting joy"...

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: ...And I've forgotten the rest.

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: I've spent too long trying to clear the defilement that remains in this place. The exhaustion is clouding my mind...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't push yourself too much! It doesn't matter if you can't remember some quotations. Just say stuff in a more relaxed way!

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Well then, let me think... Though the Sunyata Flowers are not the most precious thing within the Vourukasha Oasis, they are exceedingly dear companions to our people.

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Many Pari spend time with those flowers after they've finished their work for the day.

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: It would be like a human growing up alongside those creatures that go "Meow-meow" and "Woof-woof"...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You mean cats and dogs?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, so that's how it is. Y'know, if Paimon had one of those as a pet for a while, and it got sick, Paimon would be really sad too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Never mind what might happen if it was Paimon's only friend...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon understands your urgency now, Sefana. The health of the Sunyata Flowers is definitely important!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Hmm... The importance of the Sunyata Flowers is far beyond such. You're still not all that good at analogies, Sefana.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, we got the message. Since this is a serious issue, and Sorush is being so proactive, let's get going right away!

choices.text: Time to save some pretty flowers!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Just wait here for us, Sefana.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: #{NICKNAME} and I shall rid the Sunyata Flowers of the remaining defilement that plagues them shortly.

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Th—Thank you all very much!

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Not only have I troubled Sister Sorush, but also our great Yasnapati... and on our first meeting too... I must prepare some gifts for you in return...

choices.text: Time to save the Pari's pets!
So, as for the Sunyata Flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back, Sefana!

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: The Sunyata Flowers have been purged of their defilement. You need not worry any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: That's wonderful, Sister Sorush! You've always been so reliable.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: #And you too, great Yasnapati {NICKNAME}! I have prepared a gift for you...

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: I picked up some shiny objects while caring for the Sunyata Flowers. I have heard that humans and their meow-meows and woof-woofs love them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Would that be... Mora? Paimon wouldn't mind some if that were the case!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: What gift could I get you, Sister Sorush?

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: How shallow, Sefana! What I did was out of a commitment to my great work. I require not your tokens of gratitude. You should instead focus on keeping yourself and the Sunyata Flowers in good shape.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorush means to say that you don't have to feel in debt and... should take good care of yourself? She does sound like a big sister now...

choices.text: Showing love and care doesn't seem to be Sorush's strong suit...

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Nonsense! I was merely cautioning Sefana not to fail in her duty.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: To use an analogy that humans can understand, both Sunyata Flowers and Pari hail from the dewdrops of the Harvisptokhm. And that makes us family.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: The Pari who watch over the Sunyata Flowers are exposed to the constant encroachment of the defilement, so they must be wary of any bodily harm it may incur.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Despite Sefana's failings, she has guarded the Sunyata Flowers for a long time, and I shan't simply write her off.

choices.text: "Family"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whatever the case, you do care about your junior, huh... Maybe there really is a gentle side to you, Sorush!

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Gentle? Yes, I agree! Although Sister Sorush always says terrible things, she often helps me solve my problems too. She is a caring senior!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Preposterous... Such absurd diction is forbidden from now on!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: And that's all. We still have to extinguish the Sign of Apaosha. Now, enough with the chit-chat. It's time we parted ways with Sefana.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Once I carry out the great work of eliminating the power of darkness, the Vourukasha Oasis will recover its pure and pristine hues.

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Ah, are you leaving now? Then... I wish you the best of luck.

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: #I will wait for you, Sister Sorush, great Yasnapati {NICKNAME}, and the Pale Companion!

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Next time we meet, I'll tell many, many stories about Sister Sorush to the great Yasnapati and the Pale Companion. Do hear them out!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Hmph... I doubt if there will be a "next time." But if you do get to tell my stories, feel free to share anything you know, as it will help flesh out my Yasnapati's record of my great undertakings.

choices.text: In that sense, they are very important, indeed...
Maybe she was once very nice to Sefana...

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: The power of darkness hasn't been fully stopped... But all flower ponds have been purified and regained vitality...

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: What is happening? Is someone helping me?

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: If it's true, maybe the Harvisptokhm has graced me and these ponds with her blessings... How fortunate we are!

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: It has been some time, Sefana.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Wait, do my eyes deceive me? ... It's you, Sister Sorush! You're back!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: You won't suddenly leave again, will you? You won't be gone for a long, long time, right? Right?

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: #Calm down. My comings and goings are not the point. What is important is that I and my Yasnapati, {NICKNAME}, have come to inform you that we've made up for your failings.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: I pursue the great task of extinguishing the Sign of Apaosha, and along the way, I eliminated this dark corrosion and rescued all our flower ponds. But remember, Sefana, this was on account of your failings!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: S—So it is all thanks to you, Sister Sorush!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: I... I am sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: I cannot thank you enough... I've always had butterflies in my stomach this whole time, and now I can finally breathe easy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, so Sefana calls Sorush "Sister"... But don't you think this big sister is too strict? Ugh, she's so unlovable...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Such immaturity! It is the duty of one senior to give pointers to their juniors. How can I speak softly to them in the face of such errors?

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: That... That's right! Sister Sorush has always taken good care of me...

dialogues.speaker: Sefana

dialogues.speaker: Sefana

dialogues.speaker: Sefana

dialogues.text: What a gentle Pari you are... Paimon can't imagine Sorush getting lectured by another Pari and still calling her "Sister" after that...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: P—Preposterous!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not bad, Sorush! You really made the area regain its vitality real quick, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Pari powers are quite fascinating, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: You startle pointlessly! My powers are more than enough to easily rescue the Sunyata Flower!

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: The dark corrosion expands yet, and these Sunyata Flowers are but one amongst its many victims...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: The other flower ponds have not been spared. Sefana must be in quite the fluster at this moment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This Sefana you mentioned seems like a nice Pari who works hard to take care of the flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's go help her, shall we, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Well now, I suppose it may serve as a suitable diversion upon my great work. In that case, my Yasnapati, I bid you have a care for Sunyata Flowers of this kind.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll tell you when I see them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! Let's save these pretty flowers together!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: *sigh* Is this... the power of darkness?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back, Sefana!

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: All the Sunyata Flowers have been revitalized. Fear no more, Sefana.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: That's wonderful, Sister Sorush! You've always been so reliable all these years.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: #And you too, great Yasnapati {NICKNAME}! I have prepared a gift for you...

dialogues.speaker: Sefana

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: What gift could I get you, Sister Sorush?

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: There's no need, Sefana. Just take care of yourself and the Sunyata Flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's surprisingly nice, and Sorush sounds like a big sister, too... You two do have a close relationship!

choices.text: Are you scared that Sefana may share a story or two about your past...

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: I'm not trying to hide anything! I just genuinely want Sefana to take better care of herself!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: After all, to use an analogy that humans can understand, both Sunyata Flowers and Pari hail from the dewdrops of the Harvisptokhm. And that makes us family.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: The Pari who take care of the Sunyata Flowers are under the constant encroachment of the defilement, which is a great burden to bear.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Sefana is a tough soul, always shouldering the responsibility on her own. And she's also been respectful to me too. It's only natural that I want to take care of her.

choices.text: "Family"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A caring Sorush, huh — Paimon didn't expect to see this gentle side of you!

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Gentle? Yes, I agree! Sister Sorush often helps me solve my problems. She is a caring senior!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: You should refrain from using this absurd way of wording things!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Ahem! Anyway, the threats to the Sunyata Flowers have been eliminated! I will pay you and these flowers a visit again someday, Sefana.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: One day, the embers of the darkness shall be no more, and the pure and pristine colors shall return to the Vourukasha Oasis!

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Ah, you've got other things to do? Then... best of luck to you!

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: I will always wait here for you, Sister Sorush, the great Yasnapati, and the Pale Companion!

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Next time we meet, please allow me to share my experiences with Sister Sorush. There are so many interesting stories that I'd love to share!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: That won't be necessary!

choices.text: In that sense, they are very important, indeed...
Ahh, do share a few embarrassing incidents of hers!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Ahem! Anyway, the threats to the Sunyata Flowers have been eliminated! I will pay you and these flowers a visit again someday, Sefana.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: One day, the embers of the darkness shall be no more, and the pure and pristine colors shall return to the Vourukasha Oasis!

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Ah, you've got other things to do? Then... best of luck to you!

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: I will always wait here for you, Sister Sorush, the great Yasnapati, and the Pale Companion!

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Next time we meet, please allow me to share my experiences with Sister Sorush. There are so many interesting stories that I'd love to share!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: That won't be necessary!

choices.text: In that sense, they are very important, indeed...
Ahh, do share a few embarrassing incidents of hers!
So, as for the Sunyata Flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Sister Sorush must know how to revitalize Sunyata Flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: What a relief! Thank you so much!
